title: Northstar Competition Lab — OLBG Tipster Paper Trading
description: Evidence-first research platform for the betting market: no bookmaker, exchange, tipster, payment-processing or order-placement client anywhere, only a local append-only paper ledger, public league data feeds, offline backtests and a deliberately dormant forward-test desk. docs/FACTS.md (nr-facts-2026-09-22.1) is the canonical generated fact sheet and the repository's own tests/test_facts.py enforces that the site agrees with it; the offline suite was executed here and passes (441 test functions collected from the sources, 499 cases after pytest expands the parametrised ones). FACT sheet numbers at this head: 441 test functions, 153 open anomalies (99 RESULT_KIND_INCONSISTENT, 48 SOURCE_EDITED, 5 TIME_CONFLICT, 1 MISSING_METADATA) and 17 hash-verified fixtures with an aggregate sha256 of 2dfbb756c66a771d2cb4a47797bdb02b8343165ba6911f893dd942cc2e68b9af. Its evidence table records 3 verified sports — football as pilot_verified, darts and ice hockey as results_pilot — and 18 as verification_blocked. The football pilot is a frozen 27-match Bundesliga 1 2024/25 sample (matchdays 1, 10, 20) with 27/27 dual-source agreement against football-data.co.uk, and the engine output has grown to 829 odds snapshots (405 on 1X2, 208 on over/under 2.5 and 216 on Asian handicap) across 13 PnL desks, eleven of the thirteen negative. Two desks are positive: ah-poisson-value-v1 shows +9.8 u at a +44.7% ROI, but its Holm-adjusted p is 0.0715 against a family size of 13, and dixon-coles-v1's +5.0 u at p_raw 0.475 is likewise not significant, so the repository claims no edge; the README's 'twelve of the thirteen lose' and 'the one positive desk' contradict its own FACTS table, and the table is the number of record (IRR-120). New this pass: full-season football accuracy desks over 306 results, where elo-favourite-3way-v1 calls 167 times at 52.1% against the 38.6% always-home baseline, and a Poisson totals desk at 61.1% against the always-over baseline's 59.8%. Ice hockey runs on the whole DEL 2024/25 season (428 events) with 7 prediction-only desks and no odds path: plain Elo makes 243 calls at 66.3% (Brier 0.446) against the always-home baseline's 59.8% over 323 calls, margin-of-victory Elo 255 calls at 65.5%, regulation 3-way Poisson 64.7% against regulation-home 59.4%, and totals O/U 5.5 Poisson at 52.3% — below the always-over baseline's 53.6%. Darts runs a 425-event 2025-26 pool (423 finished, 8 events): on the cold 2025 pool of 141 matches darts-elo-v1 made 0 selections because the maximum probability of 0.551 never cleared the 0.60 threshold, while the widened 2025-26 pool produced 48 calls graded 39 of 48 correct at 81.25% with Brier 0.349, beating the listed-first baseline's 66.3% on 421 calls; the new margin-of-victory desk adds 111 calls at 78.4%, Brier 0.358. The forward desk is live on 284 frozen pre-kickoff calls awaiting a result. OpenLigaDB data is used under ODbL 1.0 with attribution.
